URL: https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/7/27/saudi-arabia-defends-against-drone-strikes-from-iran-backed-groups
(WebFetch extract — Al Jazeera's own reporting language)

Saudi Arabia reported intercepting drones that targeted oil facilities in its eastern province and in Riyadh, attributing them to "Iran-backed armed groups in Iraq."
The Houthis separately claimed responsibility, saying they "targeted Saudi crude oil transport infrastructure" carrying oil west to the Red Sea port of Yanbu, in retaliation for alleged Saudi drone incursions into Yemeni airspace.
Al Jazeera notes "it remains unclear whether the two incidents were coordinated or separate."
(No approved-source confirmation in this article of Abqaiq operations being fully halted or of a specific volume of production taken offline.)
